hypothesis_origin: Discovered after the reciprocal-kernel probe returned NOT_DISTINCT_FROM_SINGLE_AGE_TRAJECTORY on the first 20 images/domain
scientific_question_cn: 同一个 AIO epoch-1 checkpoint 在固定 bridge time 上，是否对应不同天气域互不一致的 task-specific 条件核有效年龄？

scope.claim_type: internal held-out confirmation of an observational SB-native phase phenomenon

exclude: all 20 discovery stems/domain used by the fan-out and reciprocal probes
confirmation_split.selection: rank remaining stems by stable SHA-256 identity under this protocol, before loading pixels

measurement.reciprocal_KDD: same two-anchor common-state definition frozen in unsb-reciprocal-bridge-kernel-deflection-v1
measurement.effective_age: e_star(d,t)=argmin_e mean_image KDD(d,t,e), ties resolved to the lower epoch
measurement.M16_prefix_effective_age: same definition using the first 16 of the frozen 32 proposals

primary_inference.null: permute complete five-age image KDD profiles across domain labels with 24 images retained per label
primary_inference.bootstrap: 5000 within-domain image bootstrap draws; recompute all five effective ages and their range
passing_time_requirements: at least 4/5 domains have effective-age bootstrap modal share >= 0.80
at least three distinct modal effective ages occur across the five domains
at least 90% of bootstrap draws have cross-domain age range >= 2 epochs
primary_inference.overall_support: at least 2/3 bridge times pass all requirements
primary_inference.M16_robustness_gate: M16 and M32 effective ages agree in at least 12/15 domain-time cells

interpretation_if_supported: A single global AIO training clock does not place every weather domain at the same task-specific conditional-kernel phase. This is an SB-native All-in-One mismatch defined through bridge transitions, not through output quality or a generic gradient-conflict score.
interpretation_if_failed: The discovery-set age pattern does not reproduce on independent internal images and must not enter the paper head figure.
forbidden_post_effect_changes: remove a weather domain, bridge time, or Single age
replace domain-level mean KDD with per-image majority vote
change the tie rule, permutation unit, bootstrap gate, or M16 gate
use target quality to select the effect
